Fixed windows

Its frame looks like a casement from outside. Choose it over a picture window when it sits beside opening units and the glass lines should match.

Profile section

How it is built

A fixed unit sets the glass directly in a wide welded frame: about 3 1/16" from the edge of the frame to the glass, so from outside it reads the same as our casement and awning. The profile itself is different.

The glass is set from the room side and held by a glazing bead.

Where it fits

  • Beside or between casements or awnings
  • Larger windows, where its stronger frame adds rigidity
  • Anywhere a picture window would look too slim next to its neighbours

Glass

  • Dual or triple glass sealed units
  • Low-E coatings, argon fill
  • Quanex T-Spacer technology
  • Obscure / frosted glass for bathrooms
  • Internal grilles in several patterns

Frame & hardware

  • Multi-point locking hardware
  • Integrated screens
  • Brickmould, jamb extensions and nailing fin to suit your wall
  • Custom sizes and shapes
